records.subject: Re: Cancellation timing
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for the question. A cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately, so you won't lose the days you've already paid for.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Timber Labs
records.body:
Hi Theo,

Your workspace for Timber Labs is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Quick hand with your next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Thanks for the kind words about the onboarding flow in your ticket — glad it felt smooth, and it's now closed on our side. You've got your first project up and an invite out, which is a strong start.

Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the next useful step is getting real work into that project. Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through it with you and answer anything about your setup.

Best,
Chidi
